meta.title: A vendor's app that sends wrong totals cannot change the figures
gaps: The available operations cannot send intentionally incorrect line totals or bid totals while retaining real prices and quantities.
The available read-back fields do not expose line-total or bid-total fields, so the plan cannot verify that every total was recomputed or that ₹1 appears nowhere.
The expected rejection cannot be tied to a known application error code.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 100.
The invited QA vendor submits the bid.
As the buyer, read the bid and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
